newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel sways with volatile crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel sways with volatile crude.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was quieter on Friday amid volatile crude futures.
A cargo was offered at $135 fob NWE for Sept 20-25 dates earlier in the day, but dealers said the late drop in crude would exert bearish pressure on this offer.
A trade was done yesterday at $136 fob NWE for 40,000 tonnes headed to the U.S. on September 22-27 loading.

High sulphur straight-run cargoes were finding it harder to secure buyers because of improved supplies. E-4s were assessed around at formula +$3.50, but prices were seen susceptible to crude's fortunes. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8980
